discussion.body: SET-2.0c Grok draws -- impl status: in-progress, first working path this turn. Grok dock sees the current viewport (jpeg) plus scene JSON and mutates via tools: frames/shapes/text/paths/arrows/comments, update/delete, sequence, Imagine generate/edit, fit, style card. Proposed work is ghosts (dashed gold) until Accept/Reject. User edits always win. Ask Grok from first-run, topbar sparkle, palette, or cmd-period. Phase 2.1 (please mint SET-2.1 / FEAT-021 if you want it tracked): Grok focus is still the active view by default, but list_spaces and enter_space already let it inspect and mutate another space when asked. Not limited to the screenshot.
